gen-gf-mclaren-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru is a classic serif with terminals that stop well short of the stem and a round, constant-walled o. And McLaren, the expressive display heading, brings the showy personality, while the body text keeps the traditional, editorial footing.
gen-gf-mclaren-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One reads as a text serif of literary weight, its glyphs spread wide like knots on a slack rope. McLaren handles the expressive flourish; this one holds authority.
gen-gf-mclaren-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: McLaren is distinctive and expressive, with a big-mouthed c that is easy to read at display size. But Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif, lets each character float apart with a pipe-cleaner line, so a longer stretch of text feels traditional and open.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-glegoo: Commanding up top, refined below. MedievalSharp brings the bold, wide-mouthed drama, while Glegoo, a text serif with big counters, gives the pair its editorial backbone.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-graduate: Sharp, medieval and a touch severe. MedievalSharp stands tall with short stems, and Graduate, a serif with generous white between letters and no contrast between stems and joins, settles into a dignified, bookish hush beneath it.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. MedievalSharp, bold and commanding, takes the top spot while Hanuman handles the traditional, refined text below.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-kadwa: Bold lettering over a roomy, open text. MedievalSharp supplies the commanding heading, and Kadwa, a text serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, can sit a little smaller without losing legibility.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-noticia-text: A tall, commanding heading with a literary follow-through. MedievalSharp carries the bold, wide-mouthed drama, and Noticia Text, a classic serif with big entrances into each curve, grounds it with dignified lowercase that fills most of the letter height.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-pridi: Tall bodies and short stems mark MedievalSharp out at once. And Pridi, a text serif with generous gaps between curve ends and stems, answers with small letters that stand proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-medievalsharp-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads as a traditional serif, counters spilling outward beside a big x-height. MedievalSharp supplies the bold, commanding heading above, while Scope One's stubby ascenders and descenders keep the text refined underneath.
